paragraphs: NASA Einstein Fellow at Stanford
KIPAC Fellow at Stanford/SLAC.
Ph.D., University of Chicago in Astronomy and Astrophysics.
Advisor: Chihway Chang
Thesis: "Constraining the physics of inflation using wide-field weak lensing and tSZ surveys"
Research Interests: Weak lensing, inflation, wide-field photometric surveys, millimeter-wave surveys, cosmological simulations, data processing
B.Sc., University of Michigan, Ann Arbor in Physics.
Advisor: August Evrard
Thesis: “Stellar property statistics of massive halos in cosmological simulations”.
Intro to Astrophysics, Teaching Assistant & Guest lecturer for ASTRO 133, Introduction to Astrophysics for Majors
General Relativity, Teaching Assistant for Michigan Math and Science Scholars — a 3 week summer program for high school students
NASA Hubble Einstein Fellowship
Stanford KIPAC Fellowship
NASA Brinson Fellowship (Declined)
Perimeter Institute Senior Named Fellowship (Declined)
Princeton Spitzer Fellowship (Declined)
Berkeley BCCP Fellowship (Declined)
DES Builder, recognition for building key DES infrastructure, primarily related to image processing, catalog generation, redshift/shear estimation, and other survey calibrations/characterizations.

CCAPP Price Prize, “recognizes research excellence and exceptional promise in areas related to initiatives of the Center of Cosmology and Astroparticle physics at Ohio State University.” Awarded to two students per year, globally.
DELVE Builder, recognition for leading development of weak lensing pipeline, shear catalogs, redshift catalogs, and calibrations for the DELVE survey
NSF Graduate Research Fellow, awarded $100,000+ over 3 years for development of personal research program.
Honors Fellow, University of Michigan. Awarded $10,000 for developing undergraduate thesis work within an interdisciplinary cohort. Given to 25 students per year.
Graf-Meiland Scholar, University of Michigan. Awards $5,000 each to three students annually for excellence in interdisciplinary research and academic pedagogy

Working group lead, Synthetic Source Injection, Dark Energy Survey. Lead a group of grad students, postdocs, and senior researchers in developing data-driven methods to calibrate the image data and processing pipelines for the Dark Energy Survey legacy dataset. Our group produced the largest synthetic, calibration catalog to date.

Organizer, Broader Horizons seminar series, Astronomy and Astrophysics, University of Chicago. Lead a seminar series that invites former dept. alumni to visit the dept. and present their academic/industry experiences to our community.

Graduate Rep., Committee on dept. community, Astronomy and Astrophysics, University of Chicago. Oversee community-wide survey of dept., used to inform dept. policy changes. Lead procurement and development of dept. resources for our community, such as student guides, alumni lists, professional development seminars etc.
Volunteer lecturer, Lifelong learning Served as a speaker for the Lifelong learning program, giving astronomy talks to senior citizens.
Volunteer assistant, Space Explorers Served as voluntary teaching assistant in program for high school students in the Chicago south side community
